XIG-Resources JSON & NDJSON

```{r warning=FALSE, message=TRUE,}
# ---- Define JSON path (adjust as needed) ----
DATA_JSON <- here("data", "raw", "xig_resource_v1.2.json")

# ---- Read JSON directly (as array) ----
df <- fromJSON(DATA_JSON, flatten = TRUE)
df <- as_tibble(df)

# ---- Clean data: NA handling, column renaming, and type corrections ----
df <- df %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~na_if(str_trim(as.character(.)), ""))) %>%
  rename(
    package      = package_text,
    package_url  = package_href,
    identity     = identity_text,
    identity_url = identity_href,
    title        = name_title
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    version = str_to_upper(version),                       # e.g., R4, R5
    date = suppressWarnings(parse_date_time(date, c("Ymd", "Ym", "Y"))), # robust date parse
    status = str_to_lower(status),
    wg     = str_to_lower(wg),
    realm  = str_to_lower(realm),
    auth   = str_to_lower(auth)
  )

# ---- Quick preview ----
#print(head(df, 10))
print(summary(df))


```

```{r}
na_summary <- df %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), ~sum(is.na(.)))) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = everything(),
               names_to = "Field",
               values_to = "NA_Count") %>%
  mutate(
    Total = nrow(df),
    NA_Percent = round((NA_Count / Total) * 100, 2)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(NA_Count))
```

```{r}
na_bar <- df %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), ~sum(is.na(.)))) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "Field", values_to = "NA_Count") %>%
  mutate(NA_Percent = NA_Count / nrow(df) * 100)

ggplot(na_bar, aes(x = reorder(Field, -NA_Percent), y = NA_Percent)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#0073C2FF") +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(round(NA_Percent, 1), "%")),
            vjust = 0.5, hjust = -0.2 ,size = 3, fontface = "italic") +
  labs(
    title = "Percent of Missing Values per Field",
    x = "Field",
    y = "Percent Missing"
  ) +
  theme_healthchain(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.text.x  = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.title.x = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
    axis.title.y = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
    plot.title   = element_text(face = "bold", color = "#e86c09",
                                hjust = 0.5, size = 18),
    plot.margin  = margin(t = 25, r = 20, b = 10, l = 10)
  ) +
  coord_flip(clip = "off")
```

```{r}
# ---- Year-wise counts with NA bin + color flag ----
df_yearly <- df %>%
  mutate(
    year       = year(date),
    year_label = if_else(is.na(year), "NA", as.character(year)),
    bar_color  = if_else(is.na(year), "NA", "non-NA")
  ) %>%
  count(year_label, bar_color, name = "package_count") %>%
  filter(package_count >= 10) %>%        # adjust threshold as needed
  # order numerically, with NA bin at the end
  mutate(year_num = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(year_label))) %>%
  arrange(is.na(year_num), year_num)

# ---- Plot ----
p <- ggplot(df_yearly, aes(x = year_label, y = package_count, fill = bar_color)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = package_count),
    vjust = -0.3,
    size = 2.8,
    fontface = "italic",
    color = "black"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "NA"    = "#e86c09",  # orange for NA bin
      "non-NA" = "#0066B3"  # blue for all other years
    ),
    guide = "none"          # hide legend (optional)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Year-wise FHIR Package Count",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Number of Packages"
  ) +
  theme_healthchain(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x  = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 1, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 0),
    axis.title.x = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.title   = element_text(face = "bold", color = "#e86c09", hjust = 0.5)
  ) 
print(p)

```

```{r fig.width=7, fig.height=8 ,fig.cap="Summary Plot"}
library(scales)

# 1. Aggregate: package count per year
year_totals <- df %>%
  filter(!is.na(date)) %>%
  mutate(year = year(date)) %>%
  count(year, name = "total_packages") %>%
  arrange(desc(total_packages))

top_years <- year_totals %>%
  slice_head(n = 6) %>%     # You asked for Top 6 years
  pull(year)

# 2. Prepare per-month summary for top 6 years
df_top <- df %>%                      # <<< THIS IS df_top
  filter(!is.na(date), year(date) %in% top_years) %>%
  mutate(
    year      = factor(year(date), levels = sort(top_years, decreasing = TRUE)),
    month_val = month(date),
    month_lab = factor(
      format(date, "%b"),
      levels = format(ISOdate(2000, 1:12, 1), "%b")
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(year, month_lab) %>%
  summarise(package_count = n(), .groups = "drop")

# 3. Clean: Remove months with zero counts inside each facet
df_top_clean <- df_top %>%            # <<< cleaned version
  group_by(year) %>%
  filter(package_count > 0) %>%
  ungroup()

# 4. Horizontal Plot – preserving your settings
p <- ggplot(df_top_clean, aes(x = month_lab, y = package_count)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#0066B3", width = 0.25) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = ifelse(package_count >= 50, package_count, "")),
    hjust = -0.2,
    vjust = 0.5,
    size  = 3,
    fontface = "italic",
    angle = 0
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Month-wise FHIR Package Count (Top 6 Years)",
    x = "Month",
    y = "Number of Packages"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = comma,
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.20))
  ) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~ year,
    nrow = 2,
    ncol = 3,
    scales = "free"
  ) +
  theme_healthchain(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x  = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5, size = 0, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.title.x = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
    axis.title.y = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
    strip.text   = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    plot.title   = element_text(
      face   = "bold",
      color  = "#f26d21",
      hjust  = 0.45,
      size   = 18
    ),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    plot.margin = margin(20, 30, 20, 20)
  ) +
  coord_flip(clip = "off")

print(p)


# SAVE WITH LARGER WIDTH
#ggsave("top5_years_monthwise_FHIR_packages_wide.png",plot = p,
#  width = 22,     # <<< make the figure much wider
#  height = 8,     # height stays moderate
#  dpi = 320
#)

```

```{r }
# Count packages by 'auth'
df_auth <- df %>%
  mutate(auth = ifelse(is.na(auth) | auth == "", "NA", auth)) %>%
  count(auth, name = "package_count") %>%
  arrange(desc(package_count))

y_max <- max(df_auth$package_count)

p <- ggplot(df_auth, aes(x = reorder(auth, package_count), 
                         y = package_count, 
                         fill = auth)) +       # <<< enable conditional color
  geom_col(width = 0.7) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = package_count),
    hjust = -0.1, size = 3.7, fontface = "italic", color = "black"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(                               # <<< specify colors
    values = c(
      "NA" = "#e86c09",                            # special color for NA
      setNames(rep("#0066B3", nrow(df_auth)-1),   # all others
               df_auth$auth[df_auth$auth != "NA"])
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "FHIR Package Count by Authors",
    x = "Authors",
    y = "Number of Packages"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, y_max * 1.08),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))
  ) +
  theme_healthchain(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.text.x  = element_text(angle = 60, hjust = 1, size = 0),
    axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.title.x = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
    axis.title.y = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
    plot.title   = element_text(face = "bold", color = "#e86c09",
                                hjust = 0.5, size = 18),
    plot.margin  = margin(t = 25, r = 20, b = 10, l = 10)
  ) +
  coord_flip(clip = "off")

print(p)
# Save high-res image
#ggsave("fhir_packages_by_auth_histogram.png", plot = p, width = 12, height = 10, dpi = 300)
```

```{r fig.dpi=240, fig.height=7, fig.width=8}
# Years for faceting
years_of_interest <- c(2025, 2024, 2023, 2022, 2021, 2020, 2019, 2018, 2017)

# Count packages by year & auth
df_auth_year <- df %>%
  filter(!is.na(date)) %>%
  mutate(
    year = year(date),
    year = factor(year, levels = years_of_interest),
    auth = ifelse(is.na(auth) | auth == "", "NA", auth)
  ) %>%
  filter(year %in% years_of_interest) %>%
  count(year, auth, name = "package_count")

# Global max for scale
y_max <- max(df_auth_year$package_count)

# Color mapping
auth_levels   <- sort(unique(df_auth_year$auth))
non_na_auth   <- auth_levels[auth_levels != "NA"]
fill_values <- c(
  "NA" = "#e86c09",
  setNames(rep("#0066B3", length(non_na_auth)), non_na_auth)
)

p <- ggplot(
  df_auth_year,
  aes(x = reorder(auth, package_count), y = package_count, fill = auth)
) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = package_count),
    hjust = -0.15,
    size = 2.8,
    fontface = "italic",
    color = "black"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = fill_values) +
  labs(
    title = "FHIR Package Count by Authors (Faceted by Year)",
    x = "Authority",    
    y = "Packages Count"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, y_max * 1.10),
    labels = comma,
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.03))
  ) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~ year,
    ncol = 3,
    scales = "free_x"
  ) +
  theme_healthchain(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",

    # Remove x-axis text completely
    axis.text.x  = element_blank(),

    # 🔽 Reduce y-axis text size for better balance
    axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 10),

    # Keep axis titles clean
    axis.title.y = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
    
    axis.title.x = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),

    plot.title   = element_text(face = "bold", color = "#e86c09",
                                hjust = 0.5, size = 20),

    # Increase spacing between facet panels for readability
    panel.spacing = unit(1.4, "lines"),

    plot.margin  = margin(t = 25, r = 20, b = 15, l = 20)
  ) +
  coord_flip(clip = "off")

print(p)

```

```{r}
# Count packages by 'version'
df_version <- df %>%
  mutate(version = if_else(is.na(version) | version == "", "NA", version)) %>%
  count(version, name = "package_count") %>%
  arrange(desc(package_count))

# Max for scaling
y_max_ver <- max(df_version$package_count, na.rm = TRUE)

# Safe color mapping: all versions blue, NA (if present) orange
version_levels <- unique(df_version$version)
fill_values_ver <- setNames(
  ifelse(version_levels == "NA", "#e86c09", "#0066B3"),
  version_levels
)

p_ver <- ggplot(
  df_version,
  aes(
    x    = reorder(version, package_count),
    y    = package_count,
    fill = version
  )
) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = package_count),
    hjust    = -0.1,
    size     = 3.7,
    fontface = "italic",
    color    = "black"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = fill_values_ver) +
  labs(
    title = "FHIR Package Count by Versions",
    x     = "FHIR Version",
    y     = "Number of Packages"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, y_max_ver * 1.08),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))
  ) +
  theme_healthchain(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.text.x  = element_text(angle = 60, hjust = 1, size = 0),
    axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.title.x = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
    axis.title.y = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),

      color = "#e86c09",
      hjust = 0.5,
```

```{r fig.dpi=240, fig.height=7, fig.width=8 }
      face = "bold", color = "#e86c09",

    panel.spacing = unit(1.4, "lines"),

    plot.margin  = margin(t = 25, r = 20, b = 15, l = 20)
```

```{r fig.width=12, fig.height=10, fig.dpi=240}
# ---- Year-wise counts for Version R5 only, with NA bin + color flag ----
df_yearly_r5 <- df %>%
  filter(version == "R5") %>%
  mutate(
    year       = year(date),
    year_label = if_else(is.na(year), "NA", as.character(year)),
    # bar_color is no longer needed if coloring by status
  ) %>%
  count(year_label, status, name = "package_count") %>%  # <--- group by year_label AND status!
  filter(package_count >= 10) %>%
  mutate(year_num = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(year_label))) %>%
  arrange(is.na(year_num), year_num)

# ---- Plot ----
p_r5 <- ggplot(df_yearly_r5, aes(x = year_label, y = package_count, fill = status)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = package_count),
    position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
    size = 2.8,
    fontface = "italic",
    color = "black"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Year-wise FHIR Package Count (Version R5 Only, Colored by Status)",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Number of Packages",
    fill = "Status"
  ) +
  theme_healthchain(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x  = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 1, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.title   = element_text(face = "bold", color = "#e86c09", hjust = 0.5)
  )

print(p_r5)
```

```{r}

# Ensure proper year sort and put NA last
df_unique_first_year <- df %>%
  mutate(
    year_label = if_else(is.na(year(date)), "NA", as.character(year(date)))
  ) %>%
  group_by(package) %>%
  summarize(first_year = min(year_label)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  count(first_year, name = "unique_package_count") %>%
  mutate(
    year_num = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(first_year))
  ) %>%
  arrange(year_num) %>%
  mutate(
    bar_color = if_else(first_year == "NA", "NA", "non-NA"),
    first_year = fct_relevel(first_year, c(sort(unique(first_year[first_year != "NA"])), "NA"))
  )

ggplot(df_unique_first_year, aes(x = first_year, y = unique_package_count, fill = bar_color)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = unique_package_count),
    hjust = -0.15,
    size = 2.8,
    fontface = "italic",
    color = "black"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "NA"     = "#e86c09",   # orange for NA bin
      "non-NA" = "#0066B3"
    ),
    guide = "none"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Year-wise Unique FHIR Package First Release Count",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Number of Packages"
  ) +
  theme_healthchain(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x  = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y  = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.title   = element_text(face = "bold", color = "#e86c09", hjust = 0.5)
  ) +
  coord_flip()

```

```{r fig.width=7, fig.height=9, fig.dpi=150}

df_unique_yearly_status <- df %>%
  mutate(year_label = if_else(is.na(lubridate::year(date)), "NA", as.character(lubridate::year(date)))) %>%
  distinct(year_label, package, status) %>%  # group by year, package, AND status
  count(year_label, status, name = "unique_package_count") %>%
  arrange(year_label)

p_status <- ggplot(df_unique_yearly_status, aes(x = year_label, y = unique_package_count, fill = status)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = unique_package_count),
    position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),  # recommended for stacked bars
    size = 2.8,
    fontface = "italic",
    color = "black"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Year-wise Unique FHIR Package Count (Grouped by Status)",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Number of Packages",
    fill = "Status"
  ) +
  theme_healthchain(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x  = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 1, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.title   = element_text(face = "bold", color = "#e86c09", hjust = 0.5)
  ) + coord_flip()

print(p_status)

```
